task.title: Use JSON editor
task.shortdesc: Open the complete profile as a Firefox policies.json document for exact review or raw editing.

prereq.p: Open a saved profile. JSON editor works on a saved profile and represents the profile as a Firefox boundary document.

context.p: JSON editor is the raw document surface. Use it when Guided or All settings is too high-level for exact review, migration checks, troubleshooting, or raw values.

image.alt: JSON editor showing editable Firefox policies JSON for a saved profile.

step.cmd: Open the saved profile from the Library or another editor.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.
Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Confirm the editor shows a top-level policies object and the download action is available.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Use JSON editor only when exact raw document control is needed.

info.note: Saving raw JSON can change the canonical BPM profile. Validate syntax and policy values before saving.

result.p: The current profile is visible as editable Firefox policies.json content.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the route cannot open, save the profile first or return to All settings for visual editing.
